What you can check on your own:

  3. Fund your account – Add the first deposit ($250 at Clear Accrudance) with one of the payment methods on offer.

Clear Accrudance Fees and Minimum Deposit

To start trading at Clear Accrudance you need a minimum deposit of $250. Before you deposit, look for the following in the current terms:

  • The trading spread and any commission on each trade.
  • Withdrawal charges and the minimum withdrawal amount.
  • Inactivity or account maintenance fees.
  • Currency conversion fees if the deposit is not in your own currency.

Opening an account costs nothing, the platform says.

Accepted payment methods, as stated by the platform: e-wallets, bank transfer and cards.

Clear Accrudance Login, Registration and App

Registering with a platform like Clear Accrudance typically takes a few minutes:

Clear Accrudance Withdrawal Process

Payouts are where many platforms differ. Before you deposit at Clear Accrudance, look for:

  • Processing time, and whether it depends on the payment method.
  • Identity verification (KYC) documents and when they are requested.
  • Whether you must withdraw to the same method you deposited with.
  • The minimum withdrawal amount and any withdrawal fee.

Testing a small withdrawal early shows you how payouts work before you commit more.

It may not suit you if you need a long-established provider with a confirmed regulator, or an income you can leave on autopilot.
